† [גְּנָזִים] n.[m.]pl. 1.chests (?); 2. treasury—only pl. cstr. גִּנְזֵי;—
1. perhaps chests of variegated cloth ג׳ בְּרֹמִים Ez 27:24 so Thes AV RV; Sm Co al. cloths, carpets, Ew Taschen.
2. treasury (NH גֶּנֶז, Aramaic גִּנְזָא, גְּנִיז, Biblical Aramaic cstr. pl. גִּנְזֵי; Pers. loan-word from گَنْجَه treasure? cf. Vullers ii. 1032 Lag Ges Abh. 27); גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ Est 3:9; 4:7.
